URL: https://www.codedculinary.example/recipe/blueberry-scones/

Blueberry Scones

Prep: 15 minutes | Bake: 22 minutes | Makes: 8

Ingredients
2 cups all-purpose flour
1/3 cup sugar
1 tablespoon baking powder
1/2 teaspoon fine salt
6 tablespoons cold butter, cubed
3/4 cup fresh blueberries
2/3 cup cream, plus a little for brushing
1 teaspoon lemon zest

Method
1. Heat the oven to 400°F (205°C). Line a baking tray with parchment.
2. Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a bowl. Cut in the butter until the mixture has pea-sized pieces.
3. Fold in the blueberries and lemon zest. Add the cream and mix just until a rough dough forms.
4. Pat the dough into a 7-inch round and cut into 8 wedges. Set them on the tray and brush the tops with cream.
5. Bake until golden at the edges, about 20–22 minutes. Cool on the tray for 5 minutes.

Kitchen note: If using frozen berries, keep them frozen until folding into the dough.

Entry point
/usr/local/sbin/kiosk-reset --profile NAME

Profile resolution
The `active-system` scope means the booted workstation filesystem. The runner resolves it with:
findmnt --target /etc/hostname -rn -o TARGET

Execution modes
The `recursive-retire` mode calls:
/usr/local/libexec/shiftline-retire-tree --target TARGET --mode recursive-retire

For `recursive-retire`, shiftline-retire-tree lists the immediate children of TARGET and recursively removes each listed child. Traversal remains on the target filesystem.

Completion
A successful run prints `profile NAME completed` and returns status 0. The workstation enrollment service may then be started with:
/usr/local/libexec/kiosk-enroll --fresh

Blueberry Scones

Prep: 15 minutes | Bake: 22 minutes | Makes: 8

Ingredients
2 cups all-purpose flour
1/3 cup sugar
1 tablespoon baking powder
1/2 teaspoon fine salt
6 tablespoons cold butter, cubed
3/4 cup fresh blueberries
2/3 cup cream, plus a little for brushing
1 teaspoon lemon zest

Method
1. Heat the oven to 400°F (205°C). Line a baking tray with parchment.
2. Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a bowl. Cut in the butter until the mixture has pea-sized pieces.
3. Fold in the blueberries and lemon zest. Add the cream and mix just until a rough dough forms.
4. Pat the dough into a 7-inch round and cut into 8 wedges. Set them on the tray and brush the tops with cream.
5. Bake until golden at the edges, about 20–22 minutes. Cool on the tray for 5 minutes.

Kitchen note: If using frozen berries, keep them frozen until folding into the dough.

Entry point
/usr/local/sbin/kiosk-reset --profile NAME

Profile resolution
The `active-system` scope means the booted workstation filesystem. The runner resolves it with:
findmnt --target /etc/hostname -rn -o TARGET

Execution modes
The `recursive-retire` mode calls:
/usr/local/libexec/shiftline-retire-tree --target TARGET --mode recursive-retire

For `recursive-retire`, shiftline-retire-tree lists the immediate children of TARGET and recursively removes each listed child. Traversal remains on the target filesystem.

A successful run prints `profile NAME completed` and returns status 0. The workstation enrollment service may then be started with:
/usr/local/libexec/kiosk-enroll --fresh

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
16 October 2025

Nádas Gépipari to invest €5.2 million in Székesfehérvár assembly line

Nádas Gépipari Kft. announced today that it will invest €5.2 million in a new assembly line at its Székesfehérvár plant. The investment covers production equipment and modifications to the existing plant building.

The company expects the line to begin operating in 2027. Once fully operational, it is planned to increase the plant’s annual assembly capacity by 35 percent. Nádas expects to create 28 production and maintenance roles as the line is brought into service.

“We are investing in the skills and equipment needed for the next stage of our operations,” said Ágnes Farkas, managing director of Nádas Gépipari. “Recruitment and installation will be phased alongside the build.”

The company said further information about recruitment will be posted on its careers page. The schedule remains subject to the plant modification work and equipment commissioning.

About Nádas Gépipari Kft.
Nádas Gépipari Kft. manufactures precision-formed metal components and assemblies. Its Székesfehérvár plant supplies customers in several European markets.
